venue: Madrid, Bernabéu (roof closed or not, no weather factor)
market: CIN −3.5, total 52.5. Burrow 36.5 attempts / 25.5 completions; Penix 31.5 / 20. Bijan Robinson 19.5 carries.
lineup: Both starting QBs healthy. ATL: Brian Robinson Jr. (RB2) is out, so Bijan's backup is Khalil Herbert; edge James Pearce Jr. back from an eight-game suspension (snap count unknown). CIN: WR3 Andrei Iosivas and TE Erick All out; CB DJ Turner was day-to-day early in the week.

keys.take: Bijan Robinson's explosive runs. ATL runs on 49.3% of plays (3rd).
keys.how: Cincinnati hasn't built its defense to do it: five-plus DBs on 82% of snaps and a light box on a league-high 39.9% of runs. It is betting on taking away the pass and winning the scoreboard.
keys.gives: Run lanes. CIN allows 5.1 yards per carry to backs and has allowed nine 20-yard runs (31st).
keys.counter: Score early so ATL has to pass. In ATL's Week 6 loss to Chicago, Bijan got 9 carries.

keys.take: Tee Higgins in the 10–19-yard window. He leads the NFL in catches and yards on those throws.
keys.how: Pressure (41.6% rate, 4th) and single-high coverage (60.7%, 3rd most).
keys.gives: One-on-ones outside. ATL allows 9.4 yards per target to outside receivers (26th), and Burrow has the league's lowest pressure rate (31.1%) because he gets it out fast from shotgun.
keys.counter: Burrow throws on time to Higgins and Chase. Five of the seven QBs who threw normally against ATL passed for 286–312 yards.

scripts.control: CIN leads. Burrow still throws enough (30 attempts and 292 yards in the Week 7 rout of Baltimore), and Chase Brown gets the closeout carries. ATL has to throw into a defense that holds QBs to 41% completions under pressure, which is Penix's weak spot (28.6% under pressure).
scripts.competitive: CIN's five close games averaged 41 pass attempts. Burrow's volume is the safest stat on the board, and Bijan gets 18–22 carries.
scripts.reversal: ATL leads by running into light boxes. Burrow throws more, not less: 54 attempts in the Week 4 loss to JAX and 48 in the Week 8 shootout. Bijan's carries hold up only if ATL is the one leading.

plays.why: ATL's plan to pressure and play single-high runs into the quarterback who is pressured least, and gives Higgins the intermediate one-on-ones he leads the league on.
plays.support: Sharp Football (Hribar, Nov 3): ATL single-high 60.7%, Burrow pressured on 31.1% of dropbacks, ATL 26th vs outside WRs.
plays.sample: Burrow cleared 275 in 4 of 7 starts this season and 7 of his last 12 dating to 2025. Five of seven QBs who threw normally against ATL topped 285 (Young, Love, Shough, Williams, Purdy).
plays.counter: Week 5: 190 yards in a 31–24 win where CIN ran 29 times. A rout can cap him.
plays.loses: CIN goes up big early and runs Chase Brown in the second half, or ATL's run game keeps Burrow to nine possessions.
plays.vs: Beat 250+ (68¢, needs 70%), which is more likely but thinner on price, and 300+ (40¢), where his 2-of-7 and ATL's 2-of-7 don't support the jump.

plays.cond: Only at 53¢ or less, and only if Iosivas is inactive (he's listed Out).
plays.why: Same thesis as Burrow's yards, aimed at the receiver ATL's coverage favors. Iosivas being out narrows the target tree.
plays.support: Higgins is targeted on 24.2% of routes against single-high (Sharp Football).
plays.counter: Chase out-targeted him 16–11 last week, and our backtest has receiving-yard Yes prices about 5 points rich.
plays.loses: ATL rolls coverage to Higgins and Chase gets the volume, or a blowout trims the second half.
plays.vs: Ranked behind Burrow 275+ because a receiver's single-game share is noisier than his QB's total.

passed.name: Bijan Robinson 100+ rush yds (47¢)
passed.why: The thesis is real (light boxes, Brian Robinson out), but the price already moved with it, and rushing-yard Yes prices have run about 8 points rich in our backtest.
passed.move: Atlanta leading early, or Herbert inactive. Either way he'd get 22+ carries.

passed.name: Drake London 80+ rec yds / No side
passed.why: CIN is 31st against slot receivers, but Penix completes 28.6% under pressure and DJ Turner's status is unknown. The two signals cancel.
passed.move: DJ Turner inactive would flip this to a Yes lean.

passed.name: Kyle Pitts 40+ rec yds (56¢)
passed.why: CIN allows 89 yards a game to TEs, but Pitts has cleared 40 in only 3 of 6 Penix starts.

passed.name: Chase Brown 55+ rush yds No (54¢)
passed.why: The model likes the No, but he cleared 55 in 4 of 7, and ATL just gave up 310 rushing yards.

sources.t: AP via KSAT — Stefanski prepares Falcons for Bengals (Nov 4)
